engine: lab/vuoto_f4_core.py: Feynman form in the discrete time of the rule (period = list of operations; electron Feynman propagators with equal-time sea density; light walk as photon; Peierls vertex at every hop; A_ext A_gamma contact; Coulomb 4 pi alpha/q^2 after every coin with its sea-response vertex; overlap diagrams where the external vertex shares a period with a loop vertex). No effective Hamiltonian, no slice.

development_checks_done_before_this_file.Feynman self-energy = phase-3 engine (re: identical to 1e-12; the equal-time sea term adds only a state-independent imaginary constant
development_checks_done_before_this_file.full Brillouin zone of R: the Floquet gap at quasi-energy pi CLOSES at k=(pi/2,pi/2,pi/2) (1e-14, all theta): the full-zone sea is not gapped there, sums converge only ~1/M^2; full-zone light is therefore NOT an exam (exploratory only). The light is dressed by the sea of the physical species (occupation n(k)=w(k), declared).

definitions.a: one-loop, LINEARIZED: a = (r - 1) + dm/m - dv_j - dv_q, r = tr(T^dag V)/tr(T^dag T) - delta mu_P/mu_P (Breit frame p = -Q/2 e_q, p' = +Q/2 e_q, Q = 1e-2 kmin, current along j != q); products of O(alpha) terms are two-loop and are not kept (they carry large logs: 0.1 alpha/2pi at theta 0.05)
definitions.dv_j, dm: dressed limiting speed and mass of the electron (phase-3 definitions, same engine)
definitions.delta c_gamma: from omega^2 = mu^2 + c^2 q^2 at q = 0.05 m and 0.1 m (photon mass mu^2 of the species cut SUBTRACTED, declared debt); per dressed polarization (eigenvectors of the 2x2 Hermitian part)
definitions.key number: Delta_iso = <dv_e> - <dc_gamma> (averages over x, y, z), units of alpha, same cut, same theta

light.weights: occupation n(k)=w(k), pair weights by filled state

extrapolations: a -> 0: straight line in theta through the 4 points (as phase 3); kmin -> 0: straight line in kmin

exams.G1 Ward: rerun at production grid, R axes x,y and C axis x: |V/F1 - (1 + dSigma/dmu)| <= 1e-6
exams.G2 g-2 mean: mean of the 6 pairs, a->0 and kmin->0: PASS if |mean/(alpha/2pi) - 1| <= 0.03, per case
exams.G3 spread: max - min over the 6 pairs at a->0: 'survives' if >= 0.01 alpha/2pi, 'vanishes' if < 0.01; the power of theta of the spread is reported (fit over the 4 theta)
exams.G4 C isotropy: C: spread <= 1e-6 alpha/2pi at every theta (symmetry)
exams.G5 checks: |Im r| and structure residual <= 1e-8 for every run
exams.L1 symmetry: R: |dc_x - dc_z| <= 0.002 alpha (both polarizations); C: max - min over x,y,z,(111) <= 0.002 alpha
exams.L2 systematics: grid, q choice and weight scheme change dc_gamma by <= 0.005 alpha
exams.L3 birefringence (coordinator input): difference of the two dressed polarizations per direction. Symmetry prediction for R (D4h with axis y): ZERO along y (the 4-fold rotation about y maps one polarization into the other), ALLOWED along x and z. 'seen' if |difference| >= 0.002 alpha at a->0. C: none expected
exams.L4 unitarity: anti-Hermitian residue of delta Omega_gamma / Omega <= 0.01 alpha
exams.K key number: Delta_iso per case at a->0: 'physical difference' if |Delta_iso| >= 0.01 alpha; also reported: anisotropy of electron and light (y minus mean of x,z) and their difference
